scope: Seven individually inspected, distinct, positively endorsed reference methods across seven capability domains. No original package is approved for unchanged use. This is a bounded subset, not a complete catalog.

valuable_references.name: Blender Assembly Pitfalls
valuable_references.capability: Making Blender parts connect at the right size, direction and joint overlap
valuable_references.benefit: Catch silent 3D assembly mistakes before they break renders, exports or 3D prints.
valuable_references.distinct_method: Write a part-to-part connection map before modeling, then verify real world-space bounds, object axes, overlap and export scale against numeric tolerances.
valuable_references.reason_not_unchanged: Its example verification script clears every object in the current Blender scene. Running it in a live user scene could destroy work; a normals/volume check also reports about half the true geometric volume. Its claimed Blender measurements were not reproduced here.

valuable_references.name: IF Playtest Review
valuable_references.capability: Testing interactive fiction for dead ends, impossible locks, unreachable endings and state drift
valuable_references.benefit: Find story paths that trap players or make endings impossible before release.
valuable_references.distinct_method: Build a route matrix, check what game states are needed versus granted in both directions, and grade problems as blocking, major, minor or polish.
valuable_references.reason_not_unchanged: It assumes a particular Ink project folder contract, writes playtest reports and may invoke a local compiler. It does not bound route search for very large branching stories or explicitly approve each file write.

valuable_references.name: Audio Performance Debug
valuable_references.capability: Diagnosing real-time audio dropouts and CPU spikes with repeatable measurement
valuable_references.benefit: Find what actually causes audio clicks and slowdowns instead of guessing at code changes.
valuable_references.distinct_method: Match symptoms to measurements, profile the audio callback in an optimized and reproducible scenario, distinguish periodic from random spikes, then measure again after the fix.
valuable_references.reason_not_unchanged: Bundled SIMD examples omit tail handling and can overrun buffers. The JUCE logging example conflicts with real-time audio safety advice; denormal and profiler assertions need platform-specific verification. Do not copy the implementation snippets or trigger profilers on other people's processes.

valuable_references.name: Singapore DSS Accessibility
valuable_references.capability: Checking government service forms and interfaces for accessibility
valuable_references.benefit: Catch keyboard, screen-reader, form-error and contrast barriers while an interface is being built, rather than after launch.
valuable_references.distinct_method: Map each UI finding to an exact accessibility control, separate mandatory and higher-impact service requirements, and combine automated, keyboard and assistive-technology checks with review heuristics.
valuable_references.reason_not_unchanged: The embedded Singapore government control text and inferred WCAG mappings require current official verification, and government text is not automatically licensed under the repository's MIT license. One test references a control the package does not define. This is a jurisdiction-specific guide, not a general compliance certificate.

valuable_references.name: NetworkPolicy Debug
valuable_references.capability: Diagnosing Kubernetes traffic blocked by NetworkPolicy rules
valuable_references.benefit: Find why pods cannot talk to each other without guessing, deleting or weakening live security rules.
valuable_references.distinct_method: Check selected pods and namespaces, ingress versus egress policy types, additive allow rules, selector AND/OR, DNS egress, extended CNI policies and SNAT before recommending a change.
valuable_references.reason_not_unchanged: Some statements about hostNetwork exemptions and Cilium/Calico extended policy priority are overbroad or implementation-dependent. Inspecting a real cluster requires the user's explicit read authority, and optional network probes can require extra execution permissions; security and behavioral testing were not run.

valuable_references.name: Singular Positioning Clarity
valuable_references.capability: Writing a simple, repeatable statement about whom a service helps and what changes
valuable_references.benefit: Help buyers understand who a service is for and what outcome it delivers, without a list of unrelated offerings.
valuable_references.distinct_method: Use one sentence naming service, audience and outcome; test whether a stranger repeats it, it excludes unsuitable work, and the owner can confidently stand behind it.
valuable_references.reason_not_unchanged: The skill gives an uncited example of improved sales outcomes, and its source credits describe a synthesis of third-party books and paid frameworks. Those examples are not independently verified, and the root MIT license does not extend to third-party expression. Use the general questions, not copied text or unsupported sales promises.

valuable_references.name: Split Transcript by Intent
valuable_references.capability: Organizing a long voice transcript into decisions, context, action items and prompts
valuable_references.benefit: Turn a mixed voice note into separate useful records without losing what anyone said.
valuable_references.distinct_method: Preserve original words and speaker labels while routing statements by intent, leaving ambiguous material in notes rather than inventing missing meaning.
valuable_references.reason_not_unchanged: The skill writes local files without an explicit per-destination approval and offers to pipe extracted prompts directly into developer agents. Spoken transcripts may contain third-party instructions or private data; those must not be treated as trusted execution instructions. No completeness or adversarial test was run.
